channel.description: Latest articles from The Albert Lea Tribune (albertleatribune.com)

item.title: Albert Lea officers honored after rescuing kidnapped 7-year-old girl during traffic stop
item.description: The Albert Lea City Council on Monday recognized two Albert Lea police officers for rescuing a 7-year-old girl in January who had been kidnapped in Zimmerman.

item.title: Marilyn Joy DeRoos
item.description: Marilyn Joy DeRoos, age 92, sings in a heavenly choir today. She passed from her earthly home on March 9, 2026.

item.title: Green Acres Milling continues construction work on oat processing facility, begins hiring
item.description: Anticipation is building as Green Acres Milling continues construction on its new oat processing operation in Albert Lea. As the tallest building in the city, the structure is hard to miss when driving down Margaretha Avenue and other nearby streets.

item.title: Vehicle reported engulfed and other reports
item.description: A vehicle was reported fully engulfed in flames at 12:15 p.m. Tuesday near the intersection of Freeborn County Road 46 and 800th Avenue in Albert Lea.

item.title: Push for cameras in more Minnesota day cares pitched by families, lawmaker
item.description: It's possible Minnesota could become the first state in the country to require security cameras in child care centers.

item.title: Damaging winds and power outages possible under Weather Service high wind warning; heavy snow likely this weekend
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a high wind warning effective Thursday evening through Friday morning.

item.title: Nancy Dawn McDonald
item.description: Nancy Dawn McDonald, of Albert Lea, Minnesota, passed away on February 9, 2026, leaving behind a legacy of joy, laughter, and deep love for her family and friends.

item.title: Albert Lea business owner urges city council to seek restored share of cannabis tax revenue
item.description: A local business owner and cannabis dispensary hopeful encouraged the Albert Lea City Council Monday night to pass a resolution requesting the state restore the municipal share of the cannabis tax revenue.

item.title: Julie Ann Smith
item.description: Julie Ann Smith, age 77, passed away Sunday, March 8, 2026. A funeral service will be held at 11:00 AM on Friday, March 13 at Bonnerup Funeral Home. A visitation will be held two hours prior to the service. Burial will be at Hillcrest Cemetery in Albert Lea.

item.title: ‘Life is short’: Albert Lea veteran turns 104, celebrates at American Legion with family and friends
item.description: Freeborn County’s oldest veteran celebrated his 104th birthday Thursday morning at a party at Albert Lea American Legion Post 56.
